info.title: AITASKER Backend API
info.description: Interactive API documentation for the AITASKER backend.

tags.name: SoW Generation
tags.description: AI generate Statement of Work for jobs

tags.name: Expert Candidates
tags.description: Rank expert candidates for a job posting from saved SoW keywords

tags.name: Expert Recommendations
tags.description: Generate and read saved AI expert recommendations for jobs

get.description: Public Business profile for Guest access (US-017). No JWT required. Returns the business profile with fullName enriched from the related account; 404 when the profile is not found. Sibling routes /me, /by-job/{jobId} and /business remain protected.
Read saved expert recommendations without calling AI.

post.description: Generate and persist Top 5 expert recommendations for a job.
Generate structured SoW, milestones and milestone budgets from raw job requirements.

get.description: Public Business-by-job profile for Guest access on OPEN jobs (US-018). No JWT required at the route level; the service layer still enforces that only OPEN jobs are public, while non-OPEN jobs require STAFF/ADMIN/BUSINESS. 404 when the job or business profile is not found.
Extract SoW keywords and rank matching expert portfolios.

status.description: Live status from milestones table, falling back to contract_milestones.status when linked milestone is missing

duration.description: Snapshot of milestone duration at contract creation time

durationUnit.description: Snapshot of milestone duration unit (DAY, WEEK, MONTH) at contract creation time

criteriaSnapshot.description: Acceptance criteria text captured at contract creation time, joined by newlines. Stays stable after source milestone edits.

deliverableExpectation.description: Deliverable expectation text captured from milestone description at contract creation time. Stays stable after source milestone edits.
